sources.snippet: Luce DFlash ports block-diffusion speculative decoding to GGUF on the RTX 3090, with measured 2.56x mean speedup on Qwen 3.6-27B — see our DFlash bench article for the full methodology. And Qwen3.6-27B-MTP-GGUF lands in llama.cpp via PR #22673 as of May 4, adding native multi-token prediction for the dense model.
